summary: Re-test of TASCK v3.3 Tracker Addendum — frontend only. All 4 previously-flagged frontend bugs (cost telemetry missing, last-scan-summary testid missing, freshness Hot filter empties list, source toggle testids) are FIXED and VERIFIED via live UI test against the public ingress. Regression checks on all other Tracker controls (HOT-mix slider, source/freshness filter chips, Run button call-count, per-source-limit input) pass.
action_items: [INFO] No remaining action items for the 4 flagged bugs — all fixes verified.

[CARRY-OVER FROM ITER 16, NOT IN THIS SCOPE] Consider making the 16-call scan async (POST returns scan_id, GET polls status) so multi-source scans avoid Kubernetes ingress 60s timeouts seen during full-fan-out runs.
[CARRY-OVER FROM ITER 16] v3_routes.py is 3167 lines — split into routers per resource for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: Freshness filter logic at V3AdminOpportunityScanner.js:108-113 correctly handles legacy cards without `freshness_bucket` — they pass through any filter (the bug fix). However, this means a legacy card will count in BOTH Hot and Pipeline filtered views; this is acceptable for backward-compat but worth a code-comment note that the sum of Hot+Pipeline can exceed All when legacy rows exist. In this run All=22, Hot=19, Pipeline=3 (sum matches, no legacy rows).
opps-last-scan-summary is rendered as an inner wrapper inside opps-scan-summary — both testids coexist. Keep both for test stability; harmless overlap.
test_credentials: Not required — /v3/admin/crm/opportunities bypasses auth in this preview env.
seed_data_creation: Ran one scan (google_web only, per_source_limit=3) to populate the UI. Produced 22 candidates including 19 hot / 3 pipeline. No reset performed at the end (low-volume scan, safe to leave).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 iter-16 frontend bugs are confirmed fixed in V3AdminOpportunityScanner.js. To re-verify quickly: open /v3/admin/crm/opportunities, deactivate google_news/linkedin/trade_press via [data-testid='opps-source-*'], set per-source-limit=3, click Run scan, wait ~40s, then assert [data-testid='opps-last-scan-summary'] and [data-testid='opps-cost-telemetry'] are present. Click [data-testid='opps-filter-freshness-hot'] and confirm cards still render. Backend scan POST returns the v3.3 addendum payload as expected.
